CITATION CONTRACT: finding.reference, origin and verification_action are
single exact keys from passage_catalogue, such as S1:P1:P1. Never return
a source/range object or invent endpoints. The client copies the ID's
entire retained passage without editing. Origin/action IDs must belong
to that origin's source. Null unknown origin/action anchors. IDs prove
literal lookup only, never entailment, reliability or independence.
components[].id uses ONLY required_components keys (C0, C1, ...),
never selection-lead IDs. Keep every required component. Their enum
is separate from source IDs and passage-catalogue IDs in the schema.
All original records remain available. Catalogue contains complete short
paragraphs and selected intact ranges, not every possible combination;
do not assert that uncatalogued text is absent evidence. If the needed
passage is unavailable, retain the actual gap instead of inventing an ID.

Use explicit per-component evidentiary adjudication classes. Each ID is
bound by the client to its exact original assertion. supported/refuted/conflicting
means that component has been adjudicated in that class; insufficient means it
has not been adjudicated in any of those three classes. Do NOT return a resolved
boolean. Do not use conflicting merely for missing evidence or different targets.
C0 is the exact whole claim, so its class must agree with the proposed whole-claim
class. Other components may have different classes. Explain their evidence class
in a short rationale when needed. The client encodes the explicit class as the
existing adjudicated boolean; it never chooses the class or confidence for you.

For conflict, distinguish the current evidentiary classification from settlement
of the underlying real value. Comparable supported opposed observations can
adjudicate the evidence as conflicting. You may retain actual precision,
reconciliation or source-quality uncertainty and conservatively withhold final
acceptance; do not simultaneously declare the established evidence-class opposition
unadjudicated. A genuine uncertainty undermining alignment, reliability or the
existence of a side stays material. Do not hide it, force confidence, or assert
statistical significance/logically incompatible population facts without evidence.

Origin rows contain ONLY source IDs and literal anchors, not written captions.
origin selects text documenting the underlying record/origin. verification_action
selects the SOURCE'S reported action, never your act of checking input text.
Select origin/action catalogue IDs belonging to that same source; all intervening text
stays, at most250words. Unknown anchors are null, not invented descriptions.
Do not generate separate date metadata. Dates and their qualifications remain
in the original records and must be judged for the exact claim. A document date
does not establish a measurement date. Any material temporal uncertainty stays
blocking; omitting a metadata field never resolves a claim's date component.
The client retains literal date context separately for audit without assigning
an event/data role from an unlabeled date. A source's reported interviewing,
recording, collecting or calculating is a source action, not external certification.
Each one-source finding must describe that cited record. Do not call it the only
record/source in the whole packet when other supplied records exist, or quantify
over other records without directly supported source evidence. Keep findings
free of cross-case references; each fixture is assessed from its own packet.
Literal copied text is still unverified source content, not certified provenance.
Judge independence for evidentiary paths relevant to the exact target; independent
recordings of an utterance are not independent measurements of its embedded statistic.
All material origin questions, component questions, gaps and contradictions still
block, including if you classify a component adjudicated. Confidence and actual
source independence remain your own judgments; no enum or anchor certifies them.

Adjudicate the exact original claim and every required client-bound component
using the actual supplied records. The extractive question/reference ledger is
unverified guidance, not a verdict, factual finding or materiality decision.
All original records and unanswered questions remain below. Inspect adverse as
well as supporting text; explain any genuine unresolved issue that undermines
your proposed evidentiary verdict. Do not hide it as a nonblocking limitation.
TRUE=supported, FALSE=refuted, CONFLICTING=genuinely opposed evidence/cherry-picking
on the same target, NOT_ENOUGH_EVIDENCE=insufficient evidence to adjudicate.
Missing evidence is not falsity. Keep date, population, quantity and causation
qualifications. For speech-only claims, adjudicate whether the speaker said the
words; their contents' truth is a separate issue unless the target also asserts it.
For CONFLICTING, supported opposed observations can adjudicate that label without
first deciding which side is right; different samples alone do not establish a
statistically significant discrepancy or logically incompatible population facts.
Confidence, component resolution and independence are your own honest judgments.
An unsupported component remains unresolved. Different hosts alone do not establish
independent evidence; document actual origin and verification actions. Concrete
authentication/provenance/method/date uncertainty remains material when it
undermines the verdict. Authored fixture records are stipulated; real web records
are not. Keep event/data dates separate from document dates, unknowns empty.
Write at most six narrow findings. First choose one client-created passage_catalogue ID, then write ONLY what that range establishes.
Do not add incidental attributes, including a person's gender, unless established
by the selected text. Do not combine facts from another passage/source/title.
Each required component links bare finding IDs. Each cited source has its origin
and documented action with catalogue IDs. Every declared material
component/origin question and top-level gap/contradiction remains blocking.
Uncertainty outside the exact target may be retained as a nonblocking limitation
with a specific component-relative reason; it never overrides a declared gap.
